four_unresolved_contract_decisions.topic: Exact fields/enums/length bounds, sanitized header/status evidence and actionable typed outcomes
four_unresolved_contract_decisions.draft_disposition: Keep observation kinds catalog_metadata_validation, documentation_reachability, payload_validation, browser_cors_observation. Persist digests/references and bounded safe status/classification/detail-code only. Unknown remains null/typed unavailable, distinct from observed zero. No body/header/credential/free-form dumps.

four_unresolved_contract_decisions.topic: Exact series key and durable attempt ordering
four_unresolved_contract_decisions.draft_disposition: Series = source identity + descriptor/config/schema role if resolved + logical record/route identity + evidence kind + origin class. Execution attempt order comes from durable intent, not arrival time or caller timestamps. Late older completions cannot regress latest_attempt.

Prefer projections from the one immutable journal stream. Never lose a latest failure, promote incomplete work to last-good, or redeliver an unknown intent. last_good is the greatest qualified success in the same series with exact proof references.

four_unresolved_contract_decisions.topic: Composition-pinned authority for retained Census/EPA fixture evidence
four_unresolved_contract_decisions.draft_disposition: Caller-supplied hashes never authenticate fresh success or broaden fixed collection admission. Census/EPA retained fixtures remain offline historical unresolved observations. Admission remains source_fixture_catalog / catalog.example.gov /data.json, one attempt per child.
